subject.title: Interactive parity with the Codex runtime: ask-user-question · plan mode · goal mode

question: Should interactive parity land as one broad rollout with update_plan default-on and experimental goalDriver, or be staged/split after the goal-driver safety fix and live channel proof?
rationale: The branch changes default tool exposure, protocol/API surfaces, channel-visible interactions, plan-mode safety, and autonomous goal continuations; automation can repair the concrete race but cannot choose the release shape or default policy.

options.title: Fix, prove, and stage
options.body: Repair the durable counter-before-fire ordering, add latest-head Slack/Telegram proof, and let maintainers decide whether to land the bundle or split it into question, plan, and goal pieces.

options.title: Accept bundle risk after proof
options.body: Land the integrated branch after the safety fix and proof if maintainers intentionally accept the larger default/API rollout in one release.

options.title: Pause or split branch
options.body: Keep the roadmap issue open and close or split this PR if the bundle is too broad for the current product direction.

recommendation.title: Fix, prove, and stage
recommendation.body: Repair the durable counter-before-fire ordering, add latest-head Slack/Telegram proof, and let maintainers decide whether to land the bundle or split it into question, plan, and goal pieces.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history around Control UI rollout and adjacent merged interactive surfaces, making them the best available owner for the release-shape decision.
